metas.name: & Sons
metas.description: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.
When an unexpected road rage incident puts his son in critical condition, an enraged father spirals down a dark path of emotional turmoil and vengeance.

metas.name: 28 Years Later The Bone Temple
metas.description: Dr. Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship - with consequences that could change the world as they know it - and Spike's encounter with Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.

metas.name: 4 First Dates
metas.description: Zara hates weddings—especially when her demanding cousin insists she bring a date to hers. Dreading the event, she enlists her best friend Jamie to help her find the perfect plus one. But each disastrous and awkward date only deepens her frustration and forces her to question what she’s really looking for. As the big day approaches, Zara begins to realize that the perfect partner might not be a stranger at all, but someone who’s been by her side all along.

metas.name: 500 Miles
metas.description: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

metas.name: 72 Hours
metas.description: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.

metas.name: A Dogs Perfect Christmas
metas.description: When a medical emergency pulls the Goss family apart, determined dog Winstead will do all he can to bring his humans back together before Christmas Eve.

metas.name: A Gangsters Life
metas.description: When two low-level criminals scam a vicious London mob and are in over their heads, they flee to rural Greece to avoid the bloody repercussions. But escape isn't that simple.

metas.name: A Great Awakening
metas.description: One of the most defining moments in American history is the story of an unlikely friendship between the Reverend George Whitefield and Benjamin Franklin.

metas.name: A Love Like This
metas.description: Paul and Leah, in a tale of two lovers, rent a Malibu beach house for the weekend, but there's more to their relationship than it seems.

metas.name: A Melbourne Match
metas.description: Georgie, a travel writer, travels to Melbourne for an assignment where she meets Zach, an ex-Australian footballer who agrees to be her tour guide and shows her that there's more to life than work.

metas.name: A Mosquito In The Ear
metas.description: After struggling with fertility issues, an American couple decides to pursue international adoption. They are matched with a 4-year-old girl named Sarvari and travel to an orphanage in Goa, India, to bring her home.

metas.name: A Scream In The Dark
metas.description: Folder: Hollywood

metas.name: A Talent for Murder
metas.description: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

metas.name: Above And Below
metas.description: A group of friends' dream diving vacation turns into a fight for survival when brutal criminals attack their boat in open waters.

metas.name: Accused The Karen Read Story
metas.description: When police officer John O'Keefe is found dead, his girlfriend, Karen Read, is charged in connection with his death. What begins as a shocking tragedy quickly ignites a firestorm that captures national attention as Karen fights to clear her name.

metas.name: Achilles Returns
metas.description: After many years, with help of Thetis and negotiations between Zeus and Hades, the Greek hero Achilles is released from the Underworld into the modern world.

metas.name: Ali G Who Iz I
metas.description: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

metas.name: Alien Storm
metas.description: A father, businessman and secret doomsday prepper escorts people to the safety of his bunker – actually an underground house – when a massive and potentially deadly fog descends and cuts the power at his home.

metas.name: Allen
metas.description: 20 years after his encounter with an alien, Petey never moved on. Now his old friend has returned, and the reason why is complicated — and unexpected.

metas.name: Amityvillenado
metas.description: In the wake of a devastating storm that destroys the infamous DeFeo house, a paranormal entity merges with a malevolent tornado, unleashing an otherworldly force upon the town of Amityville.

metas.name: Animals
metas.description: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

metas.name: Anywhere
metas.description: A lonesome roughneck commits a hasty and brutal crime after discovering his scumbag brother is planning to run off with his unfaithful wife, upending the only life he’s ever known.

metas.name: Apex
metas.description: A grieving woman pushing her limits on a solo adventure in the Australian wild is ensnared in a twisted game with a cunning killer who thinks she's prey.

metas.name: Apocalypse Z New World
metas.description: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

metas.name: Assassin Within
metas.description: A notorious assassin captured by an AI-controlled covert Agency, must navigate fractured versions of his identities to reach the system's hidden cores-and destroy it from within before his secrets are extracted.

metas.name: Atlas King
metas.description: Ex-fighter returns from exile to bury his best friend and confront old rivalries. Reuniting with his godson, a streetwise enforcer entangled with a powerful crime syndicate, the two hatch a high-stakes heist in a desperate bid to escape the grip of a ruthless mob boss.

metas.name: Aussie At Heart
metas.description: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

metas.name: Ayran Papers
metas.description: Folder: Hollywood

metas.name: Backrooms
metas.description: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

metas.name: Bad Voodoo
metas.description: Two escaped convicts break into a house and take a hostage, only to discover that the hideout houses something far more dangerous: a voodoo curse born from a grieving couple’s thirst for vengeance. As the night spirals into terror, they must battle an unseen power that feeds on guilt, blood, and lost souls.

metas.name: Balls Up
metas.description: Two marketing executives go "balls out" and pitch a bold full‑coverage condom sponsorship with the World Cup. After their drunken celebration in Brazil sparks a global scandal, they must outrun furious fans, criminals, and power-hungry officials to salvage their careers and make it home alive.

metas.name: Bare Skin
metas.description: Victims of extreme trauma are invited to a group therapy session to share their experiences in a safe setting, but as their stories are told, an unsettling truth reveals that they may all be connected in their misfortune.

metas.name: Beast
metas.description: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

metas.name: Being Heumann
metas.description: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

metas.name: Best Of The Best
metas.description: Two childhood besties join UCLA's competitive Bollywood-fusion dance team, only to find the road to the US championships is fiercer than they imagined.

metas.name: Best Pancakes in the County
metas.description: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own.

metas.name: Big Girls Dont Cry
metas.description: Over one transformative summer in rural New Zealand in 2006, 14-year-old Sid discovers desire, identity, and the internet as she imitates the people she longs to be loved by.

metas.name: Bight
metas.description: Two couples' daring foray into open relationships leads down a tumultuous path of jealousy, betrayal, and emotional devastation.

metas.name: Black Box
metas.description: Vero Airlines Flight 298 from New Orleans to Seattle becomes the center of a chilling supernatural mystery.

metas.name: Blood Witch
metas.description: Centuries after being killed for witchcraft, a mother and daughter are resurrected. They seek revenge on descendants of those responsible. As locals disappear, two journalists investigate the mysterious events.

metas.name: Borderline
metas.description: Convinced they are our secret saviors, rogue U.S. operatives abduct Mexican gang members and seed them across major American cities, unleashing criminal chaos, swaying voters by playing on nativist prejudices, and forcing law enforcement into a race to expose the plot as the escalating carnage threatens democracy itself.

metas.name: Breeder
metas.description: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

metas.name: Bride Of The Dead
metas.description: An Egyptologist in possession of a haunted Bride of the Dead amulet is the target of a tech billionaire who believes the ancient Egyptian mummy artifact holds forbidden magic that could awaken a deadly mummy curse and unlock eternal life.

metas.name: Broken Bonds
metas.description: After witnessing a fatal shootout, three struggling waitresses hide a bag of illicit cash, forcing them into a perilous web of betrayal and survival.

metas.name: Brothers Under Fire
metas.description: Captain Jordan Wright's squadron on leave for a wedding in Mexico encounters a murderous cartel. As Jordan tries to lead survivors to safety, war erupts between his squad and the cartel, forcing him into a battle to save his men.

metas.name: Buddy
metas.description: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

metas.name: Bury The Devil
metas.description: When a hospice nurse finds herself trapped with a dementia patient, she begins to suspect something else is wrong with the woman, something otherworldly, and must fight to survive the night.

metas.name: Busboys
metas.description: A pair of idiot friends believe that if they become waiters, all of their problems will be solved. They aren't entirely wrong, but they aren't entirely right.

metas.name: By Any Means
metas.description: In 1960s Mississippi, a young Black FBI agent is forced to partner with a notorious mafia hitman to investigate a wave of brutal civil rights murders.

metas.name: Capture
metas.description: After mysteriously inheriting her parents house, a lifelong orphan finds a camcorder and a collection of video tapes containing the gruesome secrets of her family's past, and the horrifying truth behind the camcorder they were captured on.

metas.name: Carolina Caroline
metas.description: A young woman, desperate to leave her small town, runs away with a charming con man, embarking on a crime and passion-filled journey through the Southeast to find her estranged mother.

metas.name: Casa Grande
metas.description: A prodigal daughter rejoins her family at their farm during a difficult time, as her ailing father faces both a terminal diagnosis and mounting pressure from competitors. Old wounds resurface as they grapple with what lies ahead.

metas.name: Caught By Love
metas.description: While on a journey of self-discovery, a resort guest gets swept into an undercover investigation for stolen jewels that turns into an unexpected and adventurous romance.

metas.name: Chefs Kiss
metas.description: An American marketing executive travels to Tuscany to revamp a pasta sauce brand. There, she clashes and subsequently falls for a handsome, stubborn local chef.

metas.name: ClayFace
metas.description: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

metas.name: Clean Hands
metas.description: Based on a true story, a veteran narcotics officer turned recovery advocate and his daughter, who struggles with addiction, confront the American drug crisis from opposing sides of the law while navigating their complicated family bond.

metas.name: Clika
metas.description: Aspiring small-town musician Chito is determined to make it big. When a clip of him performing one of his songs goes viral, he seizes the opportunity and pushes to carve out a place for himself in the new wave of Mexican-American music... and ultimately gets caught in a game more dangerous than anticipated.

metas.name: Cold Storage
metas.description: When a mutating, highly contagious fungus escapes a sealed facility, two employees – joined by a grizzled bioterror operative – must survive the wildest night shift ever to save humanity from extinction.

metas.name: Come With Me
metas.description: Working-class Simon Ward's life unravels after a traumatic home invasion, mounting problems at work and the loss of his best friend. Falling under the influence of rhetoric-spewing radio host Dalton Kirby, Simon spirals into a violent attempt to correct the injustice he believes surrounds him.

metas.name: Confession
metas.description: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

metas.name: Confinement
metas.description: Pregnant and recently widowed, Stella is taken in by her late husband’s estranged family. But beneath their generosity lies something deeply unsettling, leaving Stella fighting for her life as their obsession with her unborn child turns deadly.

metas.name: Crime 101
metas.description: When an elusive thief whose high-stakes heists unfold along the iconic 101 freeway in Los Angeles eyes the score of a lifetime, with hopes of this being his final job, his path collides with a disillusioned insurance broker who is facing her own crossroads. Determined to crack the case, a relentless detective closes in on the operation, raising the stakes even higher.

metas.name: Crime 101
metas.description: When an elusive thief whose high-stakes heists unfold along the iconic 101 freeway in Los Angeles eyes the score of a lifetime, with hopes of this being his final job, his path collides with a disillusioned insurance broker who is facing her own crossroads. Determined to crack the case, a relentless detective closes in on the operation, raising the stakes even higher.

metas.name: Cruel Hands
metas.description: A mother and her 12-year-old son flee her abusive husband and seek refuge in an abandoned farmhouse, struggling to build a safe new life as raging wildfires spread and he relentlessly searches for them.

metas.name: Cursed Hearse
metas.description: When a down on his luck hipster buys an old hearse with the hopes of converting it into a limousine service, he soon finds out that there's a lot more to the hearse than he bargained for .

metas.name: Death Name
metas.description: A young Korean American woman yearns to learn more about her heritage, not knowing the further she digs, the more she reawakens a deadly family curse.

metas.name: Deep Water
metas.description: A group of international passengers on a flight from Los Angeles to Shanghai is forced to make an emergency landing in shark-infested waters. The terrified group is forced to work together and overcome their differences if they hope to escape their sinking plane and the frenzy of sharks drawn to the wreckage.

metas.name: Demon Squad Tooth And Claw
metas.description: When a string of brutal killings are linked to a werewolf, paranormal investigator Nick Moon goes on the hunt. Battling supernatural forces, he uncovers a dark conspiracy that must be stopped before the monster strikes again.

metas.name: Dinosaur Hunt
metas.description: A rich family are brought together to a remote island for a reunion, only to learn that their father has been experimenting with dinosaurs in an attempt to find a cure for his disease. This family are forced to work together when the dinosaurs escape.

metas.name: Dirty Games
metas.description: Four crime stories follow desperate people crossing dangerous lines for money, truth, power and survival, where every choice has consequences and nobody gets out clean.

metas.name: Dirty Hands
metas.description: In the underbelly of Chicago, a routine drug deal goes bad for the Denton brothers, Richie and Danny. With a kingpin’s son murdered, a rival gang out for blood, and their own boss trying to clean up their mess, the brothers must fight for their lives if they’re going to survive until morning.

metas.name: Disclosure Day
metas.description: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.

metas.name: Disolution
metas.description: A vengeful wife uses black magic to transfer her lover's terminal cancer to her abusive husband.

metas.name: Do Not Enter
metas.description: A group of young explorers investigates an old abandoned hotel, only to encounter a strange supernatural being and a competing group looking for a legendary hidden treasure.

metas.name: Do Us Part
metas.description: When Rose—Ryan’s college best friend and unrequited love—crashes his wedding with a change of heart, years of buried emotions threaten to shatter his world. As Ryan reels, his best man must navigate a minefield of secrets to get his friend to "I do" before the past rewrites the future.

metas.name: Doctor Plague
metas.description: Jaded detective John Verney is on the trail of an ancient cult of Plague Doctors which is cutting a bloody swathe through the London underworld. Dismissed by his superiors as gang on gang killings, the murders draw Verney into an obsessive maze of a secret society conspiracy with links to the Jack The Ripper murders of 1888, putting him and his family in grave danger.

metas.name: Dont Move
metas.description: Follows a prehistoric arachnid that terrifies a stranded group of campers who hike into the wrong woods. Based on the spine-tingling horror novel from the actor best known as "Murr" on TV's Impractical Jokers.

metas.name: Dont Say Good Luck
metas.description: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical—until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.

metas.name: Double Double Trouble
metas.description: Reeling from a devastating miscarriage and the collapse of her marriage, Drea struggles to rebuild her life when her identical twin sister Ali finds love with Ryan, a man who represents everything Drea believes she's lost.

metas.name: Drive Through Fire
metas.description: The story follows an addict war veteran turned rideshare driver who helps a terrified passenger escape a human trafficking ring serving wealthy clients.

metas.name: Empire Of Lies
metas.description: When a mysterious young woman comes to interview a paranoid man living in rural isolation, he is forced to confront his part in his daughter's murder.

metas.name: Enola Holmes 3
metas.description: Adventure follows detective Enola Holmes to Malta, where her plans to tie the knot unravel when Sherlock's disappearance plunges her into a perilous case.

metas.name: Evil Dead Burn
metas.description: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

metas.name: Extra Geography
metas.description: In an English girls boarding school, two teenage best friends grapple with the challenges of girlhood—friendship, boys, studies, and growing up—and embark on their school project... falling in love.

metas.name: Faces Of Death
metas.description: A moderator on an internet video-sharing platform stumbles across a potential snuff film ring hidden in the depths of the site's content.

metas.name: Fall 2 Deadpoint
metas.description: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

metas.name: Fck Valentines Day
metas.description: Gina hates her Valentine's Day birthday and travels to Greece to prevent her boyfriend's proposal. With help from vacationers Johnny and his sister Mickey, she schemes to delay it – while questioning her relationship.

metas.name: Finding Emily
metas.description: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

metas.name: Flavia
metas.description: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

metas.name: Forbidden Fruits
metas.description: At a mall store, Apple leads a secret witch cult with coworkers Cherry and Fig. New hire Pumpkin questions their sisterhood, forcing them to confront inner darkness or meet violent ends.

metas.name: Gail Daughtry And The Celebrity Sex Pass
metas.description: After her fiance sleeps with his celebrity crush, Kansas hairdresser Gail heads to Hollywood to even the score with her own famous fantasy — Jon Hamm.

metas.name: Gaskins The Hitchhiker Killer
metas.description: South Carolina serial killer Donald “Pee-Wee” Gaskins carried out a reign of terror marked by extreme brutality. He stabbed, shot, drowned, and poisoned victims from his own community as well as hitchhikers, often targeting the vulnerable. Beneath the rural land near his home, bodies lay hidden in shallow graves, concealing years of violence. His history of crime masked the depth of his cruelty—until authorities uncovered the truth, exposing the full horror of his murders.

metas.name: Gator Face
metas.description: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

metas.name: Girls Like Girls
metas.description: After her mother's passing, 17-year-old Coley navigates new feelings of intimacy with Sonya in rural Oregon, where both girls must overcome their mutual uncertainties and self-doubt to embrace their connection.

metas.name: Glenrothan
metas.description: After thirty-five years abroad, Donal returns to his native Scotland to make amends with his estranged brother Sandy.

metas.name: Greenland 2 Migration
metas.description: Having found the safety of the Greenland bunker after the comet Clarke decimated the Earth, the Garrity family must now risk everything to embark on a perilous journey across the wasteland of Europe to find a new home.

metas.name: Grizzly Night
metas.description: On August 12, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happened: that same night, nine miles apart, there were not one—but two—fatal grizzly bear attacks.

metas.name: Guarding Stars
metas.description: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

metas.name: Hadestown The Musical
metas.description: The tragic love of Orpheus and Eurydice is intertwined with the complex relationship of Hades and Persephone. Eurydice, struggling with poverty, is lured to the industrial underworld of Hadestown by Hades, while Orpheus, a struggling musician, ventures down below to bring her back. (Filmed live at the Lyric Theatre, London, featuring the core five original Broadway cast members.)
